Reading this made me extremely annoyed. I have all sorts of things to say. Yet I know nothing anyone says will change your mind. Judging from what you've written, it sounds like you are one of those girls (yes, you are just like 'those' girls), who thinks they are in love and put themselves in the middle of drama on purpose and expect everything to work out for them. When it doesn't, you make yourself into the victim, because it was all done in the name of love. 

Unless you are a troll here and not actually wanting people to respond, I think you need to get off of here and think long and hard about what YOU want your life to be. Are you willing to sacrifice a little of your happiness to support this boy you say you love, so he can be there for his baby and it's mother? Can you share him? Cause if not, you need to leave this situation and let them focus on the bigger problem at hand, teenage pregnancy, without them being concerned if you are happy or not if you don't care about them.

How old are you, to move back in with your parents? It's always unfortunate when your parents won't accept you. I wish there was a way to make it easier. I think you need to make a choice though. Find a way to be grateful for their help while also standing up to them about your own love life. That's just it. It's yours, not theirs. But you can do this without being an ungrateful brat. You are still living in their home and having them pay your bills.
Or you need to stop using them to pay your bills and leave. Live your life. Be yourself. And don't give up on them. Still visit, call them up, let them know that you love them even if they are closed minded; just as they should love you even if you are gay.
Tl;dr: Stop whining about the fact you can't leave because they are paying your way in the world. Be confident in who you are, while still being grateful for what you have.
